I learned farming from my father and I do what worked last season. I will put one bag of fertilizer on each hectare of my maize because I saw it gives better cobs, and I will spread cattle manure too since this land is mine. I will plant my own saved seed because the shop seed costs too much and I do not trust it yet. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because the rains are enough here, and I will hire some young men from the village to help with weeding and harvest when my family cannot manage alone.
